rubrics.reason: Adequate realization with material qualifications: operating cash absorption is explained substantially by loans and AFS/HTM book growth rather than treating securities funding as industrial working capital. The cash statement explicitly removes noncash valuation gains and accrued interest; recognition policies defer unperformed services. Accrual/credit realization and refinancing remain material qualifications.

assessment.rationale: Adequate realization with material qualifications: operating cash absorption is explained substantially by loans and AFS/HTM book growth rather than treating securities funding as industrial working capital. The cash statement explicitly removes noncash valuation gains and accrued interest; recognition policies defer unperformed services. Accrual/credit realization and refinancing remain material qualifications.

evidence.rationale: Loan/investment cash deployment is separated from earnings collection; negative aggregate operating cash alone cannot establish failed realization.
Noncash FVTPL gains and impairment adjustments are separately identified, without presuming all trading income recurring or a normalized common denominator.
Loans/AFS/HTM and interest accrual cash movements are sector operating assets, not manufacturing inventory.
Deferred agency/underwriting and completion/recoverability conditions identify concrete service timing risks.

counterevidence.rationale: Interest accrual is material and operating cash remains deeply negative; lending growth creates collection/funding risk. The cash bridge proves neither future collateral recoverability nor recurring owner FCFE.

disconfirmingEvidence: Interest accrual is material and operating cash remains deeply negative; lending growth creates collection/funding risk. The cash bridge proves neither future collateral recoverability nor recurring owner FCFE.
assumptions: Reported FY2025 issuer cash and recognition basis only; no industrial CFO threshold.
invalidationConditions: Loan noncollection, material valuation reversals or service-recognition correction would undermine adequate realization.
